title: Why Your Next Coworker Will Be an AI Agent
angle: Your employer isn't replacing you with AI — they're hiring an AI to work beside you, and that changes everything about your job security and your paycheck.

scenes.voiceover: Your company just posted a job listing. The candidate? An AI agent. And it already accepted the offer.
scenes.visual_description: Bold white text slams onto black background: 'NEW HIRE: AI Agent — Start Date: Today.' Red stamp effect hits the word TODAY.
scenes.caption_overlay: Your new coworker just clocked in 👀

scenes.voiceover: It answers emails, writes reports, joins meetings, and never asks for a raise. Ever.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left shows AI agent completing tasks at hyperspeed, right shows a human worker doing the same tasks slowly. Speedometer graphic overlays.
scenes.caption_overlay: No sick days. No vacation. No salary negotiation.

scenes.voiceover: Klarna replaced 700 workers with one AI. Duolingo cut contractors. This isn't coming — it's here.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid cuts: Klarna logo, Duolingo logo, LinkedIn job listings with AI tags, office floor with empty desks. Each cut under 1.5 seconds.

scenes.voiceover: But the workers who survived? They got promoted. Because someone has to manage the AI agents.
scenes.visual_description: Speaker reacts with genuine surprise expression, leans into camera. Text pops on screen: 'THE SURVIVORS GOT RAISES.' Arrow graphic points up sharply.
scenes.caption_overlay: Wait — the humans who stayed got PROMOTED? 👀

scenes.voiceover: The most valuable skill in 2025 is knowing how to direct AI agents. Not code. Not degrees. Just this.
scenes.visual_description: Words flash rapidly: 'Coding? Nope. MBA? Nope. THIS? YES.' Final frame freezes on 'AI Agent Management' in gold text with a crown icon.
scenes.caption_overlay: The $100K skill nobody is teaching you

scenes.voiceover: So the next time you see a new hire at your company — check if they need a desk. Your answer might shock you.
scenes.visual_description: Same black background and white bold text as scene 1 returns: 'NEW HIRE: AI Agent — Start Date: Today.' Screen glitches and resets to the opening frame.
scenes.caption_overlay: Watch this again. It hits different the second time. 🔄

hook_test.viral_proof: The 'Wait, what?' format — surprising claim followed by proof and bigger reveal — has driven multiple 10M+ view videos including @hankgreen1's science shock reels and @explainithank AI disruption clips averaging 12-18M views. The cold-open job listing visual is a proven scroll-stopper used in viral LinkedIn and TikTok workforce content.
hook_test.why_it_works: Opens with a false-familiar scenario (job listing) then subverts expectation (the candidate is AI). This triggers cognitive dissonance in 2 seconds, forcing the viewer to stay for resolution. The emotional arc moves shock → intrigue → urgency → revelation → urgency → loop, which mirrors the highest-retention TikTok structures.
